F1 (1.20 x 0.75, 6 piles) only at A1; F3 (1.65 x 1.20, 12 piles) on grid 2 at rows B, C, D, drawn with the 1.65 side along x; F2 (1.20 x 1.20, 9 piles) everywhere else.
No footings at rows B/C between the grids or under the 1.20 entrance-stair stub beyond D — the stub on grid 1 (S-02) is a cantilever from D1.
